posts.text: Today marked the beginning of my Get Out the Vote campaign coverage. As we head into the midterms, I’ll be traveling across the country to speak with elected officials and voters about what’s happening on the ground. From changes to ballot restrictions and polling locations to newly drawn district maps, there’s a lot at stake as Democrats fight to take back Congress. First stop: South Carolina with California Governor Gavin Newsom. Stay tuned for more, the countdown to November 3 is on!
